functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tony_search_context(p_user_id text, p_query text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8)
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, content text, role text, score double precision, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with q as (
    select plainto_tsquery('portuguese', coalesce(p_query, '')) as query
  ),
  memory_hits as (
    select
      'memory'::text as kind,
      m.content,
      null::text as role,
      (
        case when q.query <> ''::tsquery
          then ts_rank_cd(m.search_vector, q.query)
          else 0
        end
        + (m.importance::double precision / 20.0)
      ) as score,
      m.updated_at as created_at
    from public.tony_memories m
    cross join q
    where m.user_id = p_user_id
      and (
        q.query = ''::tsquery
        or m.search_vector @@ q.query
      )
    order by score desc, m.updated_at desc
    limit greatest(2, p_limit / 2)
  ),
  conversation_hits as (
    select
      'conversation'::text as kind,
      c.content,
      c.role,
      (
        case when q.query <> ''::tsquery
          then ts_rank_cd(c.search_vector, q.query)
          else 0
        end
        + greatest(0, 0.25 - extract(epoch from (now() - c.created_at)) / 86400.0 / 120.0)
      ) as score,
      c.created_at
    from public.tony_conversations c
    cross join q
    where c.user_id = p_user_id
      and (
        q.query = ''::tsquery
        or c.search_vector @@ q.query
      )
    order by score desc, c.created_at desc
    limit greatest(2, p_limit / 2)
  ),
  recent as (
    select
      'recent'::text as kind,
      c.content,
      c.role,
      0.05::double precision as score,
      c.created_at
    from public.tony_conversations c
    where c.user_id = p_user_id
    order by c.created_at desc
    limit 4
  )
  select * from (
    select * from memory_hits
    union all
    select * from conversation_hits
    union all
    select * from recent
  ) x
  order by score desc, created_at desc
  limit p_limit;
$function$

  user_id text not null,

      and (
        q.query = ''::tsquery

      ) as score,
      c.created_at
    from public.tony_conversations c
    cross join q
    where c.user_id = p_user_id
      and (
        q.query = ''::tsquery
        or c.search_vector @@ q.query
      )
    order by score desc, c.created_at desc
    limit greatest(2, p_limit / 2)
  ),

    select
      'recent'::text as kind,
